Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.section1Body1: We respect your privacy. AutoRoam currently runs mostly on the client side (in your browser). We do not collect or store your personal data (such as exact coordinates of your current location) unless you provide them to build a route.
Privacy.section1Body2: To search for locations and build routes, the data you enter (city names or coordinates) is transmitted to third-party APIs (Open-Meteo, OSRM, BigDataCloud, Photon). It is used exclusively to fulfill your request.
Privacy.section2Body: We use your browser's local storage technologies to save settings (for example, your car's fuel consumption, selected currency). This allows you not to enter this data every time.
Privacy.section3Body: We do not sell or transfer your personal information to third-party marketing or advertising companies. Your data may only be processed by API providers for route building (as stated in paragraph 1).
Privacy.section4Body: The site may use anonymous web analytics to track overall visit statistics (so we understand which features are most popular). This data is not tied to a specific person.
Privacy.section5Body: If you have any questions regarding this privacy policy, you can contact us via the contact buttons in the site footer.

Terms.title: Terms of Use
Terms.section1Body: These Terms of Use govern access to and use of the AutoRoam service. By using our service, you agree to these terms.
Terms.section2Body: The AutoRoam service is provided "as is". We make every effort to ensure route calculations, fuel costs, and border information are as accurate as possible, but we cannot guarantee 100% accuracy.
Terms.section2ListTitle: The author is not responsible for:
Terms.section2ListItem1: Real traffic jams, roadworks, or closed borders;
Terms.section2ListItem3: Any losses or inconveniences incurred during the trip along the suggested route.
Terms.section2Footer: Always check with official sources and traffic rules of the respective countries before starting your journey.
Terms.section3Body: Our service is user-supported and free to use. To offset development and server costs, we may use affiliate links (for example, for booking hotels or buying insurance). If you make a purchase through such links, we may receive a small commission at no extra cost to you.
Terms.section4Body: We reserve the right to change these Terms at any time. Changes take effect from the moment they are published on this page.

FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Instructions, answers, and tips for using the service

build-route.question: How to build an optimal route?
build-route.answer: Enter the starting and ending points in the main widget on the home page. You can add up to 8 intermediate stops (for the free version). Click 'Build Route', and the system will lay out the fastest path, taking into account road conditions.

borders.question: How do border crossings work?
borders.answer: The system automatically detects whether your route crosses national borders. If you travel outside the Schengen zone (or vice versa), we automatically add the appropriate border checkpoints.

fuel.question: How does fuel calculation work?
fuel.answer: The calculator takes into account the total distance of the route and the average fuel consumption of your car. We use current fuel prices in the countries you travel through. The default consumption is set to 8 liters per 100 km, but you can change it in the trip settings.

hotels.question: How does automatic hotel search work?
hotels.answer: If your trip requires more than 8 hours of continuous driving, the system will suggest optimal places for overnight stays. We find stops along the route, breaking the journey into safe segments so you can rest.

export.question: How to integrate the route into Waze or Google Maps?
export.answer: The information blocks of each point on the route timeline have corresponding 'Waze' and 'Maps' buttons. Please note that navigation apps like Waze may have difficulties with multi-point routes, so for complex trips with many intermediate stops, we recommend exporting segments separately or using Google Maps.

limitations.question: What are the main limitations of the service?
limitations.answer: 1. Routes are calculated only for passenger cars. 2. Information on fuel prices is updated once a day, so slight deviations are possible. 3. The maximum number of points in one route is 10 (including start and finish). 4. Travel on toll roads and vignettes in calculations is currently approximate.
